svg.title: Money Support Agent architecture
svg.desc: A caller rings the Twilio number or uses the test call page. Vapi hears, thinks and speaks. When the caller needs a person, Vapi calls the hand-off tool on ai, whose LangGraph graph asks the backend to ring the support team through Twilio during the call. Vapi then tells the caller and hangs up. After the call the backend has ai analyse it on Azure OpenAI, saves the masked call in Supabase and emails the team. The team reviews the call and calls back from the dashboard. Admin edits sync the agent through ai to Vapi. On the test call, caller words are masked live by ai.
svg.text: Money Support Agent: how a call flows
Numbers follow one call. The orange path is the hand-off during the call. Letters follow an admin change. L is the live transcript.

g.text: calls our hand-off tool when a person is needed
guardrails and tools Vapi applies on every call
rings the team · emails · call backs
Caller: can I talk to someone from your team?
Agent: I've passed this to our support team…
I don't need your card number.
Caller words go to the backend,
then ai masks them on Azure
answers, or hands off and hangs up
Twilio rings the team phone now
opens Review, calls the customer back
